text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from the Serie A midweek round, with Venezia-Inter, Milan-Bologna, Genoa-Juventus, Monza-Napoli and Parma-Udinese.
We already had 18 goals in the first three matches last night, so expect more Midweek Madness.
There are three fixtures at 17.30 GMT (18.30 CET), as Inter need a victory at Venezia to keep up with Lazio, Milan host Bologna and Parma-Udinese is a relegation tussle.
At 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET), Juventus are away to Genoa and Napoli have a trip to unpredictable Monza.
- All
- Favourites 0
Akor Adams springs the offside trap on the Yeboah through ball and dribbles around Provedel, but the flag goes up eventually!
Okoye parries the Adrian Bernabe’ penalty!
Okoye fumbles a corner, then Abankwah charges down the Troilo shot with his arm!
Monza: Törnqvist; Birindelli, Lucchesi, Goglichidze; Bakoune, Colombo, Foe Ondoa, Mangas; Ngonge, Robinson; Varela
Napoli: Milinković-Savić; Di Lorenzo, Marín, Rrahmani; Politano, Anguissa, Lobotka, McTominay, Olivera; Lang, Højlund
HOW?!?!
Venezia waste an astonishing chance! Counter-attack, rolled across from the right and Gianluca Busio turns over from seven yards!
Camarda on for Bartesaghi.
Genoa: Bijlow; Marcandalli, Ostigard, Vasquez; Ehizibue, Frendrup, Amorim, Ellertson; Baldanzi, Vitinha; Osmajic
Juventus: Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Lucumí; Kalulu, Douglas Luiz, Sarr, McKennie, Cambiaso; Alajbegović; Kolo Muani
Incredible turnaround! Modric claims he was fouled by Pobega to start the move, Miranda got down the left and pulled it back, sensational Mbangula first touch to get away from two and fire in from seven yards!
It looked like Diawara who bundled over his own line, but the free kick actually hit Bartesaghi! They were queuing up for that own goal…
What a chance for Udinese! Series of desperate clearances, Davis shoots from 12 yards, Troilo throws himself in the path and deflects it inches wide!
Diawara and Pulisic on, Estupinan and Hutchinson off.
Cambiaghi replaces Bernardeschi for Bologna.
Bernardeschi wins it back in midfield and surges forward, cross for Odgaard who comes sliding in and turns just over from five yards!
Venezia surge forward, but the back-heel flick return pass for Lauberbach wasn’t the best idea, then Hainaut shot deflected.
Barella brings down Sohm on the counter-attack for a yellow card.
Goncalo Ramos with a knock to the knee, he’s in a lot of pain, but back on his feet. It hyperextended a little bit.
Hutchinson bringing some Premier League determination to Milan, he harasses everyone on the ball. Very nearly manages to rob Pobega.
Bernardeschi pulls a ball across the face of goal for Odgaard, Pavlovic has to intercept and clear in the six-yard box!
On the resulting corner, Odgaard header into the arms of Maignan.
Thuram effort is on target, but not powerful enough to really trouble Stankovic.
Bright start from Inter with a series of corners, trying to pin Venezia back.
Modric on, Tomori off after that fitness issue in the first half.
Looks like Musah is now playing right-back.
No changes
Several subs…
Akanji, Barella and Calhanoglu on, Bisseck, Sucic and Aleksandar Stankovic off.
Luka Modric coming on…
Samuel Mbangula had opened the scoring, but Alphadjo Cisse at the double turned it all around for Milan.
digest_he: מחזור אמצע השבוע בליגה האיטלקית מספק שורה של משחקים מסקרנים, ובהם המפגש של אינטר מול ונציה במטרה להיצמד לצמרת, אירוח בולוניה על ידי מילאן, ומשחקי חוץ של יובנטוס מול גנואה ושל נאפולי מול מונזה. המשחקים מתאפיינים באירועים רבים על הדשא, שערים, חילופים טקטיים ומאבקים תחרותיים לאורך כל דקות ההתמודדות.
